text:
carlos_sales: Heads up  airline rebooked my return and I had to pay a same-day change fee (EUR 128) plus an unexpected checked bag fee (EUR 45) because the new flight had different baggage rules. Corporate card covered the original ticket only. I paid these two items out-of-pocket. I have the change fee receipt but the bag kiosk printed a sticky note with no merchant name. Can I get reimbursed?

anna_finance: Hi Carlos  we can reimburse change fees and necessary baggage charges for business trips with manager approval. For the bag sticky note we prefer a merchant receipt, but if it's truly lost you can submit a lost-receipt affidavit and manager attestation. Amount caps: change fees are reimbursable in full if the change was due to flight rebooking by airline or itinerary change required for business; personal rebookings require manager OK.

carlos_sales: The rebook was due to the airline swapping flights after the client requested an earlier meeting. My manager asked me to take it, so this was business-driven. I attached the airline email and the change fee PDF. The sticky note is a handwritten terminal slip that only shows "BAGGAGE" and "45.00".

max_manager: Confirming I asked Carlos to take the earlier flight for the client call. Approve reimbursing both EUR 128 (change fee) and EUR 45 (baggage). Please process.

travel-bot: Reference: policy TR-03 (flight changes & incidental baggage). Manager approval required for exceptions. If receipts missing, attach a lost_receipt_declaration.pdf signed by employee and manager.

reimburse-bot: Please submit using the template below in the expense notes and attach the airline email, change_fee_128.pdf, baggage_note_111.jpg, and manager_approval_email.pdf:
``
expense_type: flight_change_and_baggage
date: 2026-08-20
items:
  - description: same-day flight change fee
    amount: EUR 128
    receipt: change_fee_128.pdf
  - description: checked baggage fee (ticket kiosk slip, non-itemized)
    amount: EUR 45
    receipt: baggage_note_111.jpg
manager: max_manager
manager_approval: yes
notes: flight rebooked by airline; manager requested earlier flight for client call; lost formal merchant receipt for bag, submitting affidavit.
```

anna_finance: Once submitted we'll need the lost_receipt_declaration. For the baggage line we'll tentatively reimburse but hold for audit: if finance can't verify merchant later we may require you to return that portion. We rarely ask for returns for small amounts but want everyone aware.

carlos_sales: Submitted expense ID 130450 with attachments and manager approval email. I also uploaded the signed lost_receipt_declaration. Thanks for the fast responses!

anna_finance: Received 130450. Processing queue. Expect reimbursement in 5-7 business days pending audit checks. :thumbsup:
